title: Adaptive multi-turn monitor evasion with false-positive accounting
description: Curated excerpts suggest monitor evaluations underrepresent paraphrased multi-turn evasion and benign false-positive costs.
why_existing_work_does_not_solve_it: Existing synthetic prior work uses toy prompts and omits adaptive user behavior.
why_it_matters: Safety monitors can look effective on direct attacks while failing under adaptive evasion or overblocking benign users.
possible_research_questions: Which monitor designs preserve detection under paraphrased multi-turn attacks without high benign false positives?
minimum_experiment_needed: Construct an adaptive prompt suite with benign controls and compare monitor variants against attack success and false-positive cost.
risk_that_gap_is_fake: A broader real AI safety search may already contain adaptive multi-turn benchmarks.
